prompt: Use case: background-extraction. This is an EDIT of the supplied six-cell character spritesheet. The last version FAILED because its gray checkerboard was painted into the RGB image. Do NOT substitute white, gray, black or any opaque color. Transparent means actual absent background pixels. Preserve the six character drawings exactly: pose, face, clothes, color, scale, pencil/notebook if present, and layout unchanged. Keep the white blouse and skin and eye highlights opaque; do not remove white regions inside the characters. Clean antialiased edges. Keep all six cells in the same 3 columns x 2 rows layout at the same locations. No new text, grid lines, shadows or objects. Output the alpha-transparent production PNG, not a screenshot of a transparency editor.
